description: Plan a small online store: page sections, product features, checkout options (Stripe Payment Links and/or thirdweb card-or-crypto checkout, both set up in the seller's own accounts), a compliance checklist, a launch checklist, honest limits and a link that opens the GYSM builder with a ready-made prompt. Free and instant: it makes no AI call and creates nothing. GYSM generates a single storefront page, not a full Shopify replacement.

currency.description: ISO currency code such as EUR, USD or GBP. Defaults to EUR.

niche.description: What the store sells, e.g. 'handmade candles' (max 160 characters).

payments.description: Which checkout option to plan for. Defaults to stripe.

products.description: Optional product names, or objects with name and price.

name: plan_online_store
title: Plan an online store page
